title: Question 2.2: Understanding Array Access After Split
instruction: After splitting, the result is stored in an array. This code extracts the individual parts.
reveal: The `randomSplit()` method returns an array with two datasets. `splits[0]` is the first dataset (training data, 80%), and `splits[1]` is the second dataset (test data, 20%). This is similar to how you might access elements in a regular Java array.
